newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index eases five points.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index eases five points.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFZ) was reduced by five points on monday to 1,442 as brokers reported a quiet opening to the week in Caper trading and generally steady rates for Panamaxes.
But market reports suggested active chaartering for grain from South America and North Pacific to Iran and Saudi Arabia.
Otherwise the main feature on Monday was fresh demand for Handy-size tonnage from both the USGulf and River Plate.
At 1300 GMT BIfFEX was mostly 15 to 16 points higher apart from near November which dropped five points. Turnover was 133 lots. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7771
